rationale: Increasing QUEUE_SIZE and SLM_KBYTES had no effect on latency, indicating that local scratchpad capacity and request concurrency are not the current bottlenecks. Since accelerator_mem_cycles accounts for 99% of total cycles and off-chip memory accesses remain high, we increase CONFIG_ACC_CACHES capacity and associativity to 1024 8 to capture more locality, aiming to reduce off-chip memory accesses and improve latency.
